༄༅/ /nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /༈/na mo gu ru badzra yo gi nī ye/de la 'dir dbang thob ca

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badzra yo gi nī ye/ de la 'dir dbang thob cing byin rlabs zab mo'i rgyud smin pa'i gang zag gis/ bsdus pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs yul gsal btab nas/ bdag sogs 'gro kun deng nas byang chub bar// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// rdzogs byang go 'phang la brten sems can kun// bsgral phyir zab mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad zlar rdo rje sems// rab dkar rdo rje dril 'dzin snyems ma dkar// gri thod 'dzin pa'i yum dang mnyam par sbyor// dar dang rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs// yab kyi thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ dkar po// de las 'od 'phros de bzhin gshegs kun gyi// byin rlabs ye shes bdud rtsi spyan drangs thim// bla ma bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yis// bdag sogs 'gro kun sdig ltung sbyang mdzad gsol// hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang nyid kyi// spyi gtsug nas zhugs nad gdon sdig sgrib kun// yongs su sbyangs te lus kun gang bar gyur// zhes brjod stobs bzhi'i gnad dang bcas/ yi ge brgya pa ci nus mthar/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// gsang gsum rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam tshig nyams chags mthol zhing bshags// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs// ma lus byang zhing dag mdzad gsol// rdor sems 'od zhu rang la thim// rang lus dag pa'i shel ltar bsam// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/

mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes gzhal med khang*// de dbus seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// dmar gsal rdo rje dril 'dzin longs sku'i chas// mtha' bskor pad zlar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam par bzhugs// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las// 'od 'phros skyabs yul thams cad spyan drangs thim// skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur// skyabs kun 'dus zhal rtsa brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mos gus drag pos gsol btab nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i/ lha mo'i tshogs kyis mchod par bsam/ phyi mchod nyer spyod nang mchod bdud rtsi'i sprin// gsang ba snyoms 'jug bde stong de kho na// 'khor gsum dmigs med phyag rgya chen po yis// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams mchod par bgyi// khyad par nang gi tshogs mchod ni/ rang sems rnal 'byor ma dpal mkha' la thon// phyag g.yas gri gug phung po'i smin mtshams su// reg pa tsam gyis thod pa ling gis gog /thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi khar bzhag la// stong gsum dang mnyam yangs pa'i snod gyur nang*// rkang g.yon nas brtsams dum bur gtub ste blugs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ha ho hrīḥbarjod pas// ye shes me 'bar thod pa'i dam rdzas kun// zhu zhing khol bas ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// thugs nas sprul pa'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis mchod// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// lan bdun/ brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gzhan yang mchod 'os zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gdon bgegs rigs drug 'gro ba kun la sbyin// tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang rnam mkhyen myur thob shog /mthar ni lha mo rang la thim/ mchod pa'i rdzas sogs mi dmigs bzhag spro na maṇḍal ci nus 'bul/ mjug tu dbang bzhi blang ba ni/

sangs rgyas kun dngos dpal ldan bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi bskur du gsol// zhes pas gsol btab brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// 'khor lo'i mgon po'i thugs kar dbyer med thim// de yi gnas gsum rdo rje'i 'bru gsum las// dkar dmar mthing kha'i 'od zer rnam pa gsum// rim dang gcig car byung nas rang nyid kyi// gnas gsum thim pas dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob// sgrib dag lam bzhi bsgom pa'i snod du gyur// byin rlabs sku bzhi'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag /bla ma 'od zhu snying dbus bam̐ yig dang*// dbyer med spros bral 'od gsal gnyug ma'i ngang*// mthar ni bam̐ yig 'ja' tshon bzhin du yal// de yi ngang las snying gar e e las// chos 'byung zla dkyil dbus su bam̐ yig mthar// sngags 'phreng 'khor ba'i zil gyis gzhi lus sbyangs// 'od kyi phung por gyur las skad cig gis// rang nyid pad nyi dus mtshan 'jigs byed steng*// rnam snang rigs bdag bcas pa'i rnal 'byor ma// dmar gsal spyan gsum nam mkha'i dbyings su gzigs// phyag g.yas gri gug thur du brkyang nas 'dzin// g.yon pas thog khrag steng phyogs bzung bas gsol// phrag pa g.yon par rdo rje'i kha ṭwāṃ bsten// thod skam dbu rgyan do shal phyag rgyas spras// zhabs zung g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dor thabs bzheng*// bde chen nyams 'bar ye shes me dbus rol// thugs srog 'od kyi snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs// rdo rje btsun mo'i zhing skur lam gyis gsal// 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ phaiṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas// lhan skyes zhing sngags rnal 'byor ma dpal kun// tshur 'dus dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la thim// dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par gyur// ye shes gzhug pa'i rkyen gyis snying ga'i bam̐// 'od zhu dbus su mkha' spyod dmar po dang*// byang nas g.yon bskor ljang dmar ser dang dkar// mtha' bskor sngags kyi yig 'bru so gnyis kyang*// rnal 'byor ma dpal dmar po re re gyur// de nas/

oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shuddhā&haṃḥ lus gnas so sor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// ngo bo lha la rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs// oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hrīṃ moṃ yo ga shuddho3haṃḥ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa rnams kyis mtshan pa yi// lus dkyil gtso mo'i thugs kar chos 'byung dbus// zla steng bam̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor// 'phros pa'i 'od kyis 'phags mchod 'gro sgrib sbyangs// pho nya gsum gyi byin rlabs nus mthu kun// bsdus thim mkha' spyod dngos grub thob par gyur// oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dam bcas grangs las ma nyung ba bzla/ yid bzlas skabs su snying ga yi// lus dkyil lte bar drangs pa dang*// lhan cig lha rnams sngags su bsgyur// sngags phreng klog pa'i tshul gyis bzla// de nas/ bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// 'gro kun mkha' spyod 'khrid par mdzad du gsol// khams gsum 'od zhu rang dang rang nyid kyang*// nā da'i bar thim 'od gsal dbyings su yal// slar yang rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa yi// lha sku go chas mtshan par gsal ba'i ngang*// snang grags rtog tshogs lha sngags chos kyi sku// dga' ba gsum dang dbyer med 'dres par gyur// dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun// mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang 'grub gyur nas// srid dang zhi ba'i rgud pa kun sel zhing*// don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /bzhi pa thun mong ma yin pa'i/ bsam mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ zhar byung rdzogs rim bsgoms pa'i mthar// lus gnas bsrang zhing rlung ro bsal// rang gi lus dbus rtsa dbu ma// phyi dkar nang dmar spyi gtsug zug /g.yas g.yon ro rkyang dkar dang dmar// yar sna sna bug gnyis su gug /rtsa gsum mar sna lte ba'i 'og /sbubs stong gcig tu gyur pa'i dbus// bam̐ yig rang sems dbyer med pa// rnal 'byor ma dpal mtheb sor tshad// gsol btab de la sems gtad pas// rlung phyir 'gro dang lhan cig tu// thugs las rang 'dra chung ngu 'phros// ro ma'i lam brgyud sna g.yas sgor// byon nas de las sprul pa'i tshogs// dpag med nyi zer rdul bzhin 'phros// 'phags mchog 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs// rnal 'byor ma gyur tshur 'dus pa// sprul pa'i rnal 'byor ma la thim// de nyid sna bug g.yon nas rlung*// nang du 'jug dang lhan cig par// rkyang ma'i lam brgyud lte ba yi// rnal 'byor ma la thim par bsam// de ltar lan bdun la sogs pas// rtsa lam sbyangs nas dngos gzhi ni// lte bar rang sems rnal 'byor ma'i// thugs las 'od 'phros lus kun gang*// 'od phung dmar po gcig tu gyur// rnal 'byor ma yang mkha' spyod la// 'byon par ring bas yar byon te// dbu ma dbu gtsug ro rkyang gnyis// zhabs mthil la 'byar je thung gyur// spyi bor byon tshe rtsa gsum dang*// lus kun lhag ma med par thim// rnal 'byor ma dpal mkha' spyod gshegs// 'od gsal dbyings su thim par bsam// bsam gyis mi khyab ngang du bzhag

/slar yang rang sems rnal 'byor ma// mkha' las sprin ltar brdol nas kyang*// mar byon gzhi lus sngar bzhin grub// slar yang 'pho sogs ci nus sbyangs// mthar ni go cha 'god pa sogs// gzhung ltar nyams su blang bar bya// gsungs pa gong gi nyer bsdu'i mtshams// slar yang rgyan dang phyag mtshan spang pa yi// lha sku go chas mtshan sogs gong ltar bya// khyad par gdams pa 'di rnams ni// man ngag thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas// tshul bzhin nyams su bstar ba na// mkha' spyod go 'phang tshe 'dir 'grub// de ltar rang gis sngon sbyar ba'i// sgrub thabs mkha' spyod lam bzang dang*// rjes su 'brel ba'i gdams pa 'di// mang du thos pa'i spong ba pa// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po yi// dam pa gong ma'i gsung bzhin du// mdor bsdus tshigs bcad phreng bar bsdebs// dge bas yid can rgya mtsho kun// mkha' spyod chen po myur 'grub shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
